claim: Registered retention claim (R9.1 flagship): RoutingPlasticity's ψ-gated pathways retain segment-A accuracy through the segment-B shift on the persistent-θ chain (structured A→B segmented stream) where NullPlasticity collapses toward chance. Pilot (3 seeds, benchmark_results/forgetting_pilot.json) measured d_retained=-1.05 and d_delta=-1.75 for routing vs null, pooled sd 0.084 on retained probe accuracy; the effect is registered conservatively on the retained-accuracy contrast. The retention readout is the held-out probe accuracy (probe_episode), definitionally identical to the pipeline's post-update free_accuracy (claim-grade per the imp-46 census) — pinned by test_probe_matches_the_pipeline_free_readout.
